O.name: Odds
O.long: Both teams' decimal odds are {N} or lower.
O.scope: Top-tier Important column only, first half of the season (before the final round-robin).

S.name: Combined ranking
S.long: The two teams' rankings add up to {N} or less.
S.scope: League standings for domestic matches; FIFA ranking for international matches. Where a cell lists more than one rank-sum threshold, each belongs to a different phase of the season (see the ranking rules below) rather than being active at the same time.

T.name: Top team
T.long: At least one team is ranked in the top {N} — included regardless of opponent.
T.scope: League standings for domestic matches (last season for matchdays 1–7, live from matchday 8); FIFA ranking for international matches.

C.name: Title decider
C.long: A match that can decide the title.

LAGS.name: League A group stage (UEFA Nations League)

full.long: Every match, including qualifying rounds for continental club competitions.

top.long: Every round from the point top-tier clubs join the cup.

separator: Conditions in the same tier are alternatives — a match needs to meet any one of them. The same applies between a competition's own conditions and the global cutoffs.

domestic.long: Both teams' real-time market values add up to €500M or more.

continental.long: Both teams' real-time market values add up to €300M or more.

international.long: Both teams' real-time market values add up to €300M or more.
The two teams' FIFA rankings add up to 120 or less.
Either team is ranked 30th or better by FIFA.

globalCutoffs.note: The sheet lists these cutoffs outside the Important / Main / Supplementary columns, so the site shows them as a separate route in — not tied to a specific tier.

rankingMethodology: Matchdays 1–7: use last season's final standings. This doesn't apply to lower-tier leagues such as the EFL Championship.
Leagues with more than two round-robins: only the last two round-robins use the ranking rules.
Important tier: ranking is only used in the final round-robin. In the first half of the season, odds are used instead.

A cell with more than one rank-sum (S) value is giving one threshold per phase, not simultaneous alternatives — e.g. Belgium's top tier uses S2 for the regular season and S5 once it splits into the championship round.
